name: Structured data and spreadsheets
description: Inspects a sheet's layout first, validates and de-duplicates, keeps changes reversible and reads back after every write.
prerequisites: Google Sheets connected in Account → Connected accounts, or files uploaded to Kriya
verification: Every write is read back with sheets_read and compared; writes are R3 and wait for the person's approval.
